# Notes on retrieval

Retrieval practice means pulling an answer out of memory instead of reading it again.

## Why it works

Each recall changes what is stored, so the next one comes easier.

```python
def review(card):
    return card.recall()  # effortful on purpose
```

## What to do

Close the book, write what you remember, then check it against the page.
